exposure: Early minimal enteral feeding (10 mL/kg/day) during therapeutic hypothermia
Nil per os (NPO) during therapeutic hypothermia
outcome: Time to reach full enteral feeding (FEF)
Type of milk fed on discharge
Time to first feed after therapeutic hypothermia initiation
Rate of being fully fed in the first week of life
Rate of breast milk feeding at discharge
cohort: Infants born at >=35 weeks gestational age diagnosed with moderate to severe Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy who received therapeutic hypothermia.
finding: Minimal enteral feeding during therapeutic hypothermia appears to be safe and leads to a shorter time to full enteral feeding and higher rates of breast milk feeding at discharge, with no cases of necrotizing enterocolitis or late onset sepsis in either group.
